data.one_liner: Common classes and utility methods for Google's ML Kit plugins
data.what_it_does: Provides shared classes like InputImage and ModelManager that are used across Google's standalone ML Kit plugins. It handles image conversion from files, paths, bytes, and bitmaps, as well as remote model management.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Google ML Kit plugins that require an InputImage
You need to manage downloadable remote ML models
avoid_when: You are targeting web or platforms other than Android and iOS
You are not using any Google ML Kit plugins
strengths: Provides a unified InputImage abstraction for multiple ML Kit plugins
Simplifies camera stream integration and image format handling for Android and iOS
weaknesses: Limited to mobile platforms (Android and iOS)
Relies on native platform channels with no processing done in Dart
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS deployment target 15.0 or newer, Swift Package Manager setup with specific linker flags, and Android SDK configurations.

alternatives.name: google_ml_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is an all-in-one package containing multiple ML Kit features instead of separate standalone plugins.
